description: Implementation of CustomerService providing methods to manage Customer entities, including retrieval, saving, updating, and deleting customers, as well as address geolocation.

classes.name: CustomerServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing customer management functionalities, extending generic service and integrating DAO and other services.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers matching the provided first name.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a customer by their unique ID.

methods.name: getByNick
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by their nickname.

methods.name: getByNick
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by nickname within a specific store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all customers associated with a specific merchant store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists customers for a store based on given search criteria.

methods.name: getCustomerAddress
methods.description: Provides the customer's address based on IP geolocation, throws ServiceException on failure.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates or updates a customer entity based on the presence of an ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a customer and their attributes.
